verdict.rationale: Stripe docs show broad first-party support for computing VAT/GST rates, tax codes, registrations, and reports that can feed invoices (stripe-tax-docs-2,7,14,18,23), and Stripe Invoicing integrates tax automatically per docs. However hands-on reports contradict full compliance: VIES VAT-number validation only fires once and must be manually re-checked for compliance (stripe-tax-comm-3), users say international VAT coverage is 'woefully incomplete' (stripe-tax-comm-11), and a documented incident left invoices in Draft/unbilled state when Stripe Tax rolled out (stripe-tax-comm-7,8). missing for 10: evidence that required VAT fields/registration numbers are automatically inserted into generated invoice documents across all supported locales, and confirmation the VIES/international gaps have been resolved.
